title: RSVP to Disaster: How One Click Installs a RAT
content: Cybercriminals are exploiting digital event invitations to distribute remote access trojans. Victims receive legitimate-looking emails with generic subject lines about special gatherings and celebrations. The messages contain download buttons that redirect users through fake CAPTCHA verification pages hosted on recently created domains. After verification, users encounter another generic... title: Clean Install, Stolen Creds: Fake WatchGuard VPN Site Serves Genuine Signed Client
content: In early October, a sophisticated credential phishing campaign targeted WatchGuard Mobile VPN users through a fake download site at watchguard-vpn[.]net. The attack used SEO poisoning to appear in search results and deployed a unique technique: after collecting victim credentials twice through browser pop-ups, it downloaded the genuine, validly signed WatchGuard installer directly from... title: Kimsuky attacks targeting Ukrainian experts in diplomacy, security, and international policy
